name: LED indicator
description: An LED with a series current-limiting resistor.

parameters.name: resistorRef
parameters.description: Reference designator for the series resistor.

parameters.name: resistance
parameters.description: Series resistance that sets the LED current.

parameters.name: pcbX
parameters.description: Module position on the board, in millimetres.

parameters.name: pcbY
parameters.description: Module position on the board, in millimetres.

parameters.name: schX
parameters.description: Module position on the schematic sheet.

parameters.name: schY
parameters.description: Module position on the schematic sheet.

notes: The series resistance is not calculated for you: pick it from the supply voltage and the LED's forward voltage and current.
The generic LED carries no manufacturer part number, so a build warns until you specify one.
